title: Move goldFindMessages literals into strings.xml
description: goldFindMessages was a hardcoded list of 3 flavor-text strings shown when a completed task rolls a bonus gold find. The 3 strings already exist verbatim as string resources bonus_find_gold_1/2/3 in strings.xml (added in this same i18n pass). context is already an existing constructor property of TaskCompleter (private val context: Context), so no new parameter is needed.
acceptance_criteria: goldFindMessages is still a private val of type List<String>
It resolves its 3 entries via context.getString(R.string.bonus_find_gold_1), _gold_2, _gold_3 in that order
No string literals remain in this declaration
Nothing else in the file changes
